records.motion: Moderate grounded attack, feet planted, small shoulder rotation, emphatic elbow extension and spear sliding 120px forward.
records.prompt:
Create SIX-frame 1536x1024 transparent RGBA animation sprite sheet,3 columns2rows, six isolated512x512 cells row-major. Russian Early Medieval mail spearman exactly matching reference: overhead silver conical helmet and ringmail mantle/hauberk, burgundy padding, leather boots/gloves, held wood round shield on left arm SCREEN RIGHT, spear in right hand SCREEN LEFT. STRICT directly overhead camera. Consistent painterly style. Revise attack to be a THRUST rather than waving the spear: spear slides bodily FORWARD screen DOWN along its axis with a clear 140px hand and tip travel from windup to full extension. Upperarm drives forward, elbow opens almost straight at extension; torso modest forward lunge. OVERHAND grip throughout, knuckles upward, elbow raised, forearm above shoulder plane; never palm-up/underhand. Whole spear rigid SAME LENGTH300px every frame, straight wood shaft, steel leaf tip toward screenDOWN, capped butt screenUP, same grip point. Weapon doesn't rotate/swing like an axe. Shield braces left arm. Helmet/body consistent physical scale ~100px helmet,190px body. Each full actor AND full shaft entirely inside its OWN cell with40px transparent margins, absolutely no crossing row/column boundaries or fragments. No background, text, groundshadow, outlines/trails. Explicit trajectory inside each localcell: spear butt y45 in ready/cockedpose, blade y345; then forward stroke butt y180 blade y480 (within guard use y465); shift spear/grip forward without growing, blade max465. Head centernear256,210 throughout, body movement restrained. sixposes1ready 2pullbackhigh 3driveforward 4maximumextension 5withdraw 6ready.
Moderate grounded attack, feet planted, small shoulder rotation, emphatic elbow extension and spear sliding 120px forward.
